subject: Air freight quote request: Frankfurt to Kuala Lumpur
body:
Hello,

please quote air freight for this shipment:

- Origin: we deliver to Frankfurt airport (FRA) ourselves
- Destination airport: Kuala Lumpur (KUL), MY
- Commodity: cleaning agent, 8 pieces
- Gross weight: 367 kg
- Volume: 2.64 cbm
- Ready date: 2026-11-28
- Service: the fastest option
- Our shipper's letter of instruction is attached to this email
- The goods are general cargo, non-dangerous

Please reply with your all-in price in EUR.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH
